items.html: Now, we have explained how, when ZA has his own Mochin — which is the light of his true internal essence, in his Gadlut — they do not come to him except clothed within the posterior of the NHY of Ima and the NHY of Aba. And so it is with all the Partzufim: the NHY of the one above, their externality, become the garment for the Mochin of the Partzuf below it, and everything enters and spreads in the Rosh and the Guf of that lower Partzuf.
